name.en: Basic medical seminar overseas dispatch program
name.ja: 基礎医学セミナー海外派遣留学プログラム

short.ja: 基礎医学セミナー海外派遣

capacity.en: Stated as 2 funded students a year
capacity.ja: 支援は年2名とされています

funding.en: Shibahara Fund support of up to JPY 3 million, adjusted by destination and period.
funding.ja: 柴原慶一基金から最大300万円（派遣先と期間により調整）

eligibility.en: Third-year medical students who want to learn basic medical research at a university or research institute abroad.
eligibility.ja: 海外の大学や研究機関で基礎医学を学びたい3年生

howToApply.en: Details are announced on TACT, and briefings are held from time to time. Ask the office.
howToApply.ja: 詳細はTACTで案内します。説明会も随時あります。国際連携室に問い合わせてください

text.en: Next call: not announced. Calls are posted on TACT; ask the office when the next one is expected.
text.ja: 次回の募集は未定です。募集はTACTで案内されます。次の募集の時期は国際連携室に確認してください

toConfirm: Number of funded students: the fund page says 2 a year, but the 2024 list under this programme shows 4 names.
The programme page on both old sites says only that it is under construction.
Month the next call is expected, and the TACT course or notice board where it appears.
